author: ILoveGTA2234
quote: I cannot fathom what the Devs were thinking when they made GTA 6. Most of the mechanics and look were re-used from Red Dead 2 (So most of the game was most likely made after 2018), most likely most of the game was made in the last couple years only and it shows. Heavier parts of the game don't even reach 20FPS on the PS5 pro. I don't want to IMAGINE what it's like on just normal playstation. I had high hopes for this game, and I genuinely was let down by the fact the Devs decided to release a game that struggles to even hit 30fps on a 800$ console.
